description: This file contains test cases for verifying the file upload endpoints and OpenAPI schema of a FastAPI application. It uses pytest and the FastAPI TestClient to perform HTTP requests and validate responses.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a FastAPI app module based on request parameters and provides a TestClient instance for testing.

methods.name: test_post_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that uploads a file to the '/files/' endpoint and checks for a successful response with the correct file size.

methods.name: test_post_upload_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that uploads a file to the '/uploadfile/' endpoint and verifies the filename in the response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test that retrieves the OpenAPI schema from the application and verifies its structure and content.
